steps.description: Create initial atomic structure file for diamond cubic silicon

inputs.si_relax.in: Input file for structural relaxation with xc=PBE, ecutwfc=60, kpoints=12x12x12, pseudo=SSSP/PBE/paw

outputs.si_relaxed.pos: Relaxed atomic positions and lattice vectors

steps.description: Perform structural relaxation to optimize lattice constant and atomic positions

inputs.si_scf.in: Input file for SCF calculation with xc=PBE, ecutwfc=60, kpoints=24x24x24, pseudo=SSSP/PBE/paw, startingpot='file'

outputs.si_scf.save: Charge density and potential data directory

steps.description: Run self-consistent field calculation to obtain converged charge density

inputs.si_bands.in: Input file for NSCF band calculation with xc=PBE, ecutwfc=60, kpoints=high-symmetry path Gamma-X-L-K-Gamma, pseudo=SSSP/PBE/paw, startingpot='file', startingwfc='file'

outputs.si_bands.save: Band eigenvalues and wavefunctions along k-path

steps.description: Perform non-self-consistent field calculation along high-symmetry k-point path

inputs.si_bands.in: Input file specifying k-path and output format

steps.description: Process NSCF output to extract eigenvalues for plotting

inputs.plot_bands.gpl: Gnuplot script for band structure visualization

validation_checks: Relaxation forces must be less than 1e-4 Ry/Bohr
Band gap should be within 10% of experimental value (~1.1 eV indirect)
K-point path must include Gamma, X, L, and K high-symmetry points
